mentions.name: RadioPuppy
mentions.description: This web app lets users listen to thousands of online live radio streams, with search and country filtering, using the radio-browser.info API for station information.
mentions.problem: The author loves listening to online radio at work to focus but didn't click with any of the existing web apps, so built one themselves.
mentions.audience: Personal-use web app built for the author's own enjoyment while working.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://RadioPuppy.com - Listen to 1000s of online live radio streams. This is a pet project for myself. I love listening to online radio while at work, helps me focus. But I didn't really click with any of the current selection of web apps out there so decided to build one myself. It uses the great API available at radio-browser.info for all the radio information.
